mentions.name: Peanut
mentions.description: A modern self-custodial money movement app that lets users move and manage their own funds directly without relying on a custodial bank, with financial self-sovereignty as its core proposition.
mentions.problem: Custodial banks can fail and put users' money at risk, as highlighted by the recent Ueno Bank collapse in Paraguay.
mentions.source_excerpt:
Working on modern, self custodial money movement. Especially relevant given recent Ueno Bank collapse in Paraguay.
